notes.title: New day - new patch!
notes.notes: This time, we have fixed the issue with the ladders. Some players were able to keep climbing them even though the ladder was left below 😀

notes.title: Update Notes 19 Aug
notes.notes:
Thank you for your continued feedback and support!

In this little patch, we've fixed one annoying issue that was accidentally slipped into release.


 When playing in Fullscreen mode the mouse cursor is now hidden.

notes.title: Update Notes 18 Aug
notes.notes: Fixed the chandeliers' fall speed on level 6. For some players, they were falling too fast, making several rooms quite challenging to complete.
